channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran’s authorities take ‘self-sacrifice’ mobilisation campaign nationwide
item.description: The IRGC says it wants to use main squares in every capital of Iran’s 31 provinces for the Janfada campaign.

item.title: Police in Albania filmed beating protester unconscious
item.description: Police in Albania’s capital, Tirana, were filmed beating a protester lying on the ground.

item.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts missiles and drones as fighting with Houthis rages
item.description: Saudi-led coalition says intercepted drone, missile launched towards Riyadh and 10 missiles targeting southern region.

item.title: Trump mocks reporter asking about Iran strikes, as Tehran says US derailed
item.description: US President Donald Trump sarcastically responded to a reporter asking about possible renewed attacks on Iran.

item.title: Obama’s Ohio, Michigan speeches: Key takeaways on Trump, Iran war, midterms
item.description: The former US president warns of rising costs, corruption and threats to democratic values ahead of the November 3 vote.

item.title: Why is Egypt so wary of getting involved in Yemen’s conflict?
item.description: As Egypt considers defending Saudi Arabia against Houthi attacks, memories of its war in Yemen in the 1960s loom large.

item.title: Israel to close West Bank crossings on election day as crackdown escalates
item.description: The Israeli Defense Forces announces restrictions on the movement of Palestinian workers in the run-up to Tuesday's election.

item.title: Gunmen kill at least 10 villagers and loot shops in north-east Nigeria
item.description: Police are searching for other casualties, with officials warning the actual death toll could rise further.

item.title: Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
item.description: Kaylub Giamanco has been hailed as a hero for killing a teenager who fatally shot three children and a teacher.

item.title: The bitter row over military service that could shape Israel's future
item.description: The ultra-Orthodox community is resisting being drafted into the Israeli army. But will they now bring down the Netanyahu government?
